entries.prompt: Create source-bound version A of the REAL NECA AMBUSH Predator2015 Convention Exclusive removable SILVER/CHROME MASK ONLY. Primary reference1 is the WHITE catalog: use the mask on the LARGE MAIN FIGURE, not the upper-right unmasked head. Lower-right catalog inset is the same shell at a reflective angle, not proof of a second finish. Reference2 macro supports the sculpt but its green scene illumination must NOT become pigment. Reference3 is the bare transparent head and reference4 packaged accessory, boundary evidence only. Keep the primary near-front slightly downward camera, tall narrow Viper-family silhouette, two short swept corner tips, center forehead spine, paired curved inset forehead lobes, stepped temple slats and tiny existing lateral fitting, ridged small nose bridge, two dark lower cheek recesses, dark central ribbed respirator with rounded end, and two long down-curved silver cheek prongs. Real finish is opaque silver/dark silver reflective paint with black recesses and restrained wear, not transparent plastic; the transparent object behind is the WEARER. Crucially the bright green eyes and black discolored surround belong to the bare biological head (reference3) and appear through mask openings: REMOVE those eyes/head and make the two real orbital apertures genuinely transparent, without inventing green glass inserts. Preserve actual rigid orbit rims. No skin/scalp/mandibles, clear dreads, neck/collar, body/armor/caster, weapon/hand/stand/package/backdrop. Do not add new horns, screws, glyphs, vents or source-unseen internal geometry. Do not invent green metal paint or colored glow from scene reflections. One full isolated rigid mask, same source sculpture and primary camera, no board/text/floor shadow. True transparent RGBA outside and within the real eye holes. Entire contour visible, approximately78–80% of canvas height with8–12% empty alpha above the short tips and below lowest prongs, generous side space. Exact small optical junction remains source-limited, no microscopic detail invention.

selfReview.notes: Opaque silver/chrome shell only; actual eye rims retained, wearer green eyes/clear head and all dreads/body removed. Source camera/proportions and Viper-family sculpt compared, no new geometry or second finish inferred from reflection.
